nav_rules.text: Shown when width <600dp AND not mini_halo AND not Kids AND not editing (notebook/note/*, notebook/canvas/*) AND not guided_setup.
Same conditions at width ≥600dp — the five destinations move to a NavigationRail.
Home · Activity · Notebook · Devices · Settings. Study is NOT a tab — it opens from Notebook / Home capture.

Turning Kids on returns to home and swaps it for Kids home. Child-safe routes: home, mini_halo, study, notebook/note/*, notebook/canvas/*, notebook/study/*. Every other route asks for the grown-up credential first.
If the phone has no screen lock, the gate cannot verify → show 'Ask a grown-up to set a screen lock' and stay put. Never fall back to a guessable PIN.

Tabs: Back from a non-Home tab → Home; from Home → leave app. Nested: Back → parent in the table. Inline pages (Appearance, Language, Halo nearby, Kids) close to Settings. Editors: Back saves draft first, then returns.
Approval sheet and read-aloud bar live above navigation — they follow the user across tabs. Only one audio owner at a time.
No external deep links are declared in source today. Internal entries only (notifications, widgets, Mini halo). Any future deep link must pass the Kids gate.
Start destination on first launch only. 'Save and leave' is durable; a 'Return to guided setup' button stays at the top until it is finished.
ONE list for everyone (no Everyday/Advanced tabs). Groups: halo · Privacy · Everyday · Connections · Help. Advanced is a single muted row at the very bottom.
Every technical thing lives in Advanced and nowhere else: model roles, custom MCP servers, technical report. No IDs, endpoints, tokens, logs, model file names or diagnostics on any other screen.
A switch inside Advanced, off by default, with a confirm. On: Labs & diagnostics appear inside Advanced only. Off: dev routes refuse to open, even from old links.

A Chat | Screen switch at the top of the Home tab. Home (Chat) stays the default and unchanged; the 5 tabs stay. On tablets ≥ 840dp landscape, Home can show Chat and Screen side by side. DESIGN DECISION pending sign-off.

light_layer.text: Soft light at the top of every screen in the accent colour. Breathes: idle 4.8 s, thinking 2.6 s, acting 2.4 s, listening 1.8 s. Apricot when halo needs you, faint red on error, one bloom on a confirmed result.
The phone itself gets a halo, but only while halo is listening as your assistant or actually acting. One sweep up both sides on invoke, then a slow pulse. Apricot when it needs you. Never spins.
A running task hugs the nav on every tab: orb, short title, real progress, Stop. Tap opens the run. Turns Apricot when it needs you.
After an answer, up to 3 next actions appear above the composer and a ghost suggestion sits in the field. Nothing is sent until you tap. Never suggests cloud, payments, permissions or deleting.
Nav, composer, sheets and the assistant card are frosted glass over the aura. No live blur below Android 12 or when the phone is hot: solid surfaces, same layout.
Listening when the mic is open. Speaking when audio plays. Edge while acting. Bloom only on a CONFIRMED receipt. Stop collapses every light in 333 ms.
